sentences.text: This appeal is filed by the claimant challenging the judgment and award dated 14.01.2020 passed by the tribunal, in MVC No.275/2018 seeking enhancement of compensation.

2. Heard the arguments and perused the material placed before the Court.

The occurrence of accident, injuries sustained by the claimant, coverage of insurance are not in dispute in this case.
4. In the present case, from the medical evidence on record it is proved that the claimant had suffered the fracture of lower end of both bones of right forearm.

sentences.text: The compensation awarded towards medical expenses and hospital charges of Rs.41,500/- is as per the actual bills NC: 2023:KHC-D:13228 and receipts produced; therefore, the same is kept intact.

Further, Rs.15,000/- towards incidental expenses like food, nourishment, traveling, attendant charges, etc., and Rs.26,500/- (Rs.13,250/-
pm., x 2 months) towards loss of income during laid up period for a period of 2 months, is awarded.
8. The doctor has stated that the claimant had suffered disability at 45% to a particular hand and 15% to the whole body.
Therefore, considering the evidence of the doctor, 15% functional disability is to be taken into consideration.
9. The accident is caused in the year 22.01.2019.
Therefore, notional income of Rs.13,250/- per month is taken into consideration, which is recognized by the Karnataka State Legal Service Authority.
The claimant was aged 40 years at the time of accident.
Therefore appropriate applicable multiplier is 15.

Hence, loss of future income due to disability is hereby reassessed and NC:
2023:KHC-D:13228 quantified as Rs.3,57,750/- (Rs.13,250/- x 15% x 12 x 15).

10. Thus, the claimant is entitled for total compensation under various heads as under:

sentences.text:
Therefore, the claimant is entitled for total compensation of Rs.5,00,750/- along with interest at the rate of 6% p.a. from the date of filing of the petition till realization, as against Rs.2,13,900/-
awarded by the Tribunal.
The respondents are directed to deposit the compensation within eight weeks from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this judgment.

12. In the result, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i) The appeal is allowed-in-part.
ii) The judgment and award dated 14.01.2020 passed by the Senior Civil Judge and MACT, Gangavathi, in MVC.No.275/2018 stands modified.
iii) The claimant is entitled for total compensation of Rs.5,00,750/-
along with interest at the rate of 6% p.a. from the date of petition till its realization.
NC: 2023:KHC-D:13228 iv) The claimant is not entitled for interest for the delayed period of 89 days in filing the appeal.
v) The respondents shall deposit the amount within a period of eight weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.
vi) No order as to costs.

vii) Draw award accordingly.
